name: Venomsting Dirk
flavour: It leaves small things crawling where the big thing fell.
note: Huge physical, added physical and chaos and poison chance on a dagger. Kills summon a few minions (Call Bonewalkers stands in for the reference spiders, which were a variant line; the trigger is capped by a cooldown).

name: Cinderfang Knife
flavour: Warm to the hand, hotter to the wound.
note: Enormous added physical and fire on a dagger, bleed chance, more fire against bleeding enemies and more physical against ignited ones. The timed fire-avatar cycle is replaced by its average: half the conversion and crit bonus all the time. The armour while not in avatar form is dropped.
drop: increased Fire Damage with Hits and Ailments against Bleeding Enemies
increased Physical Damage with Hits and Ailments against Ignited Enemies
Every 8 seconds, gain Avatar of Fire
Critical Strike Chance while you have Avatar of Fire
Physical Damage Converted to Fire while you have Avatar of Fire
Armour while you do not have Avatar of Fire

name: Charnel Wand
flavour: Fewer of them, and none of them kind.
note: Elemental damage with fewer but much stronger minions: one minion fewer, and minions deal a large amount more damage. Zombie life, resistance, size and the death explosion are dropped.
drop: reduced maximum number of Raised Zombies
Raised Zombies have +5000 to maximum Life

name: Bulwark of Grit
flavour: It asks for a smaller wall, and gives a thicker one.
note: Life and armour on a tower shield, paid for with a lower block cap and one fewer grit charge, in exchange for higher maximum resistances (always on here; the reference needed no endurance charges). The onslaught at maximum charges is dropped.
drop: to all maximum Resistances while you have no Endurance Charges
Onslaught while at maximum Endurance Charges

name: Venombound Aegis
flavour: Poison is only a slow way to be well.
note: Added chaos damage and energy shield, with higher maximum resistances and a much faster energy shield recharge while poisoned, and poison that lingers on you. The poison-per-stack regeneration is approximated by the recharge rate; the extra chance to be poisoned is dropped.
drop: to all maximum Resistances while Poisoned
Energy Shield Regenerated per Second per Poison

name: Surgemark Aegis
flavour: Each bright hit tightens the spring.
note: Spell damage and big energy shield, with Arcane Surge gained on every critical strike and a boost to spell crit (the reference scaled it per spectre; one spectre is assumed). The spectre life and the spectres' share of the surge are dropped, and so is the crafted support gem level.
drop: Gain Arcane Surge when you deal a Critical Strike
Your Raised Spectres also gain Arcane Surge
Critical Strike Chance for Spells per Raised Spectre

name: Snapjaw Bulwark
flavour: The door shuts on whatever follows you in.
note: Grants the jaws trap skill with trap damage, physical damage, life, flat physical damage taken reduction and spell dodge. The power charge on throwing a trap is dropped.
drop: Power Charge on Throwing a Trap

name: Brood Warden
flavour: Everything under its shade grows a little stronger.
note: Plus levels to socketed minion gems with mana, energy shield, spell damage and stronger auras on you. The aura effect on minions and the tar are dropped.
drop: Effect of Auras on your Minions

name: Howlcall Buckler
flavour: Shout, and the legs remember how to run.
note: Evasion, movement speed, cold resistance and area of effect, with a chance for onslaught when you cast (warcries are spells here; the reference gave it on every warcry) and longer warcry buffs in place of the warcry effect.
drop: Onslaught for 4 seconds on using a Warcry

name: Rootspire Bulwark
flavour: Planted, and it keeps what it plants.
note: Life, life regeneration and heavy armour with wider totem skills and a little life leech from totem damage.
drop: Area of Effect for Skills used by Totems
Damage dealt by your Totems is Leeched

name: Totembound Rampart
flavour: Wherever the post stands, so do you.
note: Huge life with Blood Magic, more totem damage, and one additional totem. The armour per active totem is a flat amount (one totem assumed); the other keystone variant is dropped.
drop: additional Totem summoned at a time

name: Almsgiver Kite
flavour: Spend it on others and it comes back doubled.
note: Life, lightning and chaos resistance, wider auras, and charges on kill and hit. The reference granted them to nearby allies; here they go to you.
drop: Area of Effect of Aura Skills
to grant a Power Charge to nearby Allies on Kill
to grant a Frenzy Charge to nearby Allies on Hit

name: Hatchery Warden
flavour: A fresh brood for every blow it turns.
note: Plus three levels to socketed minion gems, energy shield, mana, and stronger auras on you, with life regeneration after blocking. The aura effect on minions and the tar are dropped.
drop: Effect of Auras on your Minions

name: Hexhold Roundel
flavour: A curse lingers longer on a patient hand.
note: Item rarity and block with longer curses. The longer duration of curses on you is dropped.

name: Ossuary Staff
flavour: Count the bones and call the roll.
note: Block while wielding a staff, plus two to minion gems and a large minion damage bonus. The per-skeleton, zombie, spectre and raging spirit scaling lines are dropped.
drop: Chance to Block Attack Damage per Summoned Skeleton

name: Briarsnare Rod
flavour: Every step it takes is a trap for someone.
note: Staff linked to the trap support, with damage, life and mana and block.

name: Marshsnare Rod
flavour: Sunk in the bog, set for the next foot.
note: Staff linked to the trap, cluster trap and trap-and-mine damage supports, with damage, life and mana and block.

name: Roarbound Cleaver
flavour: Silence it, and it only waits.
note: Enormous added cold on a two-handed axe, with movement speed and elemental damage while a Kindled Fury warcry is active (the reference counted any warcry used recently). The warcry knockback is dropped.
drop: Movement Speed if you've used a Warcry Recently
Elemental Damage if you've used a Warcry Recently

name: Streakbreaker Axe
flavour: The longer the run, the wider the swing.
note: Physical damage and attack speed on a fast axe. The rampage streak is approximated by a flat area bonus and a small frenzy-charge chance on kill (fervour here).

name: Twinfire Cleaver
flavour: One side burns, the other rots.
note: Both fire and chaos added damage on a two-handed axe, plus flat attack block and physical damage. The reference counted as dual wielding and split the flat damage by hand; here the axe carries both and the block is unconditional.
drop: additional Chance to Block while Dual Wielding

name: Barrowmaul
flavour: Heavy enough to wake what lies under it.
note: Huge physical damage with socketed melee and minion gem levels, mana and minion life and longer skill effects.

name: Gravemaul
flavour: A lighter swing for a shorter grave.
note: Stun duration, socketed melee and minion gem levels, mana, minion life and a smaller skill effect duration bonus. The strength requirement reduction is dropped.

name: Regent's Writ
flavour: Each word is a small army.
note: Three additional minions, minion life, damage and long minion durations, with accuracy on a sword.

name: Regent's Flight
flavour: Ride out before the crown can fall.
note: Three additional minions, minion life, damage, movement speed and long minion durations, with accuracy on a sword.

name: Bonepact Wand
flavour: Paid in advance, collected in the dark.
note: Spell damage, intelligence and three additional minions with minion speed and damage. The reserved life is modelled as a flat reduction of maximum life; the chaos inoculation restriction is dropped.
drop: Cannot be used with Chaos Inoculation

name: Wraithcall Staff
flavour: Something always answers the dying.
note: Huge spell damage, cast speed and mana regeneration, with a chance on kill to call spectral motes (Whirring Motes stands in for the phantasm; the reference triggered it by consuming corpses). The minion flat physical damage and the corpse regeneration are dropped.

name: Hoarwhisper Staff
flavour: A quiet that arrives as frost.
note: Grants a cold area spell (Rime Spires stands in for the reference ice storm), with block, cast speed, intelligence and spell damage per ten intelligence. The support gem level is dropped.

name: Quakefuse Staff
flavour: Count to three and keep your feet apart.
note: Staff linked to the blastchain mine support, with spell damage, block, a lower enemy stun threshold and mines that repeat once more.
drop: Mines can be Detonated an additional time
